scope: Shared CRT-free Win32 capture and SDK-free geometry/report selectors replace three independent frontend probes. Actual production Present functions query each raw fact once and reuse the capture in the state report; D3D9 deliberately recaptures after attempting a foreground/restore mutation. D3D8 geometry-only Present avoids GDI/foreground work. Independent native Win32/GDI mocks cover full/none/partial, negative origins, 2..32 and oversized regions, failed APIs, hidden/identity mode and explicit D3D8/9/DDraw fallback policies. 17/17 probe/Present and 10/10 report cache semantic mutants are killed, with ASan/UBSan. New frozen real XP trace passes 22 independent Win32 steps and 27 reports and SwiftShader/Metal surface replay; previous 4G1 fixture is retained. All three published retail DLLs are exact tested XP window probe bytes. Existing host bundle is unchanged. Common WinEvent registration/lifetime, remaining guest adapters and stages 5/6 continue.
